The piQTL project

The protein-protein interaction-based QTL or piQTL project aims to understand how genetic variations across of a population of yeast inbreds could potentially influence the quantitative variation of the protein-protein complex formation.



Description

Manhattan plots are showing the location of piQTLs along the entire yeast genome. piQTLs are defined as peaks that pass by the thresold shown by the blue line.

QQ plots (for quantile-quantile plot) is a probability plot, that show the comparison between the expected and the experimental p-values resulting from the association tests that compare the variance of the quantity of PPI complexes and between the different type of genotype.

The graphs are interactive.

Instruction

For loading the piQTLs from a specific PPI under a specific drug, select your PPI of interest and your drug of interest by selecting them from the choice boxes.
